column1: # G3 requires all 737 entry points implemented-or-N/A. This file is the ROLLING
# candidates list for the N/A half: any session that meets an entry point it
# would otherwise stub around appends a row RIGHT THEN, while it still has the
# context to explain why -- never end-loaded onto EPG23.
# Jeremy rules on CATEGORIES, not items. Once a category is ratified (listed
# below), filing an entry point under it is mechanical; only oddballs need a
# ruling, batch-reviewed at GOs. Ratified categories so far:
#   guile-internals GC/smob/Guile-init plumbing (rationale of the original
#   font-plumbing   fontconfig/Pango/FreeType discovery, replaced by the
#   instrumentation profiling machinery that measures LilyPond's OWN execution
#                   rather than doing anything to the music (ratified by Jeremy
# NEVER N/A: doc-introspection entry points -- they are EPG24's IMPLEMENTED
# Rules (D25): an accepted N/A binding still EXISTS and THROWS
# "not applicable: <reason>" -- it never silently answers #f. The G3 fence
# computes 737 = implemented + categorized-N/A and fails on any uncategorized
# stub. N/A is reversible by demand: if the ratchet or Phase 4 reaches an N/A
# binding, the row flips back to owed, with the demanding file recorded.
# Columns: entry-point <TAB> upstream-file <TAB> reason <TAB> proposed-category <TAB> status
